issue: Candidate71 exhaustive 25-nature classifier rescue could hide an OCR error in another structured field by changing nature
fix: Keep OCR-supported nature evidence resolution and single-field consistency rescue.
Do not apply a nature discovered only by exhaustive classifier search across all 25 natures.
When classifier-only exhaustive search finds a different unique nature, leave the recognized nature unchanged and set natureNeedsReview=true.
Record the blocked diagnostic suggestion as structuredRescue.attempts.natureClassifierOnlySuggestion.
safety: Classifier may validate OCR-supported nature candidates, but it may not invent a nature with no OCR support.
